coverage: Release succeeds again after target eviction when the fence has already been removed.
Delayed release for an earlier snapshot refuses a later snapshot fence and preserves 503 admission.
Existing native tests retain premature-release, malformed-fence and flush-failure coverage.
limits: Released is an unfenced postcondition, not historical proof of a particular release operation.
Snapshot IDs must be unique per operation; caller must keep durable retirement/release progress.
No production deployment or whole-namespace release coordinator is qualified by these tests.
